name: Nature's Bolt
description: Unleash nature's power at a target. Choose: deal poison damage (attack roll), apply 1 poisoned stack (auto), apply 1 corroded stack (auto), or heal (no roll). Can be cast multiple times per turn.

name: Nature's Touch
description: Heal an ally in melee range. May spend 1 additional AP to end 1 Envenomed effect. Can be cast multiple times per turn.

name: Grasping Vine
description: Call upon nearby vegetation to lash out. If a tree or bush is within 15 ft of the target, it must succeed on a STR save or receive 1 Disarmed stack.

name: Sudden Growth
description: Force nature to erupt from the ground. A massive plant grows at a point within range forming a 5 ft radius base rising 20 ft high. Creatures on the area are lifted. Climbing costs 1 AP per 20 ft.

name: Toxic Spore
description: Plant a volatile spore in target. CON save or take poison damage. If target is Envenomed, infection spreads to all creatures within 5 ft (same save/damage). Does not chain further.

name: Hardened Skin
description: Reaction. When an attack hits you, gain 8 PA until the end of the current creature's turn.

name: Acid Spatter
description: Unleash a corrosive wave in a 15 ft cone. All creatures gain 1 Corroded stack and receive an Envenomed effect of [spell modifier + 5 + 4d4] lasting 3 rounds.

name: Speak with Animals
description: Understand and communicate with animals for the duration. Animals regard you as friendly when Animal Protector is active.

name: Hidden Message
description: Inscribe a message onto natural elements. Druids and designated creatures perceive it automatically. Others need Investigation check vs spell DC or magic to detect. Dispelled by certain spells or Arcana check vs 5x spell save DC.

name: Summon Sapling
description: Summon a sapling that obeys your commands. AC equal to yours, 1 HP (takes max 1 damage per instance), 30 ft MS. Acts before your turn. Counts as a tree for spells/abilities. Leaves a trail of natural ground.

name: Wall of Trees
description: Choose 2 trees within range. A wall of wood forms between them with HP equal to half your max HP, AC 1, and treant resistances. No creature or attack can pass through.

name: One with Nature
description: Become invisible in nature as long as you don't attack. Investigation check exceeding your spell DC reveals you. You can move but are not invisible while moving.

name: Thornbark
description: Reaction. Protect a creature with thick bark providing [6x spell modifier + 70 + 10d12] temp HP and stunning them. Melee attackers take [2x spell modifier] piercing damage (ignores armor) while temp HP is active. Unwilling targets get a WILL save.

name: Grasping Roots
description: Vines strike all enemies in a 30 ft long 5 ft wide line. CON save or take piercing damage and be rooted for the duration.

name: Acid Ray
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit, deal poison damage and reduce target's PA for the duration: -4 PA if wearing armor, -8 PA if wearing heavy armor.

name: Suffocating Cloud
description: Create a suffocating cloud (20 ft radius, 50 ft high) centered on a point. Area is semi-obscured (attacks through/in have disadvantage). Creatures starting turn inside are silenced and suffer drowning effects.

name: Seed of the Seeker
description: Create a magical seed. Know its exact location always (unless blocked by lvl 4+ spells or MATERIAL). If carried by a creature, sense their basic strong emotions.

name: Seed of Replenishment
description: Plant a seed that grows each turn. Designated creatures can eat it (must be adjacent). Heals [2x spell mod + 18 + 4d6], increasing by the same each turn up to 2 turns max.

name: Spiked Weapons
description: Grow spikes on an ally's weapon. Their weapon attacks deal additional piercing damage for the duration. Cannot affect more than 1 weapon at once.

name: Sprung Vines
description: Spawn vines in 30 ft radius area. Creatures walking through take piercing damage (ignores armor) per AP spent moving. Vines destroyed by fire and slashing. Vines on burning surfaces are instantly destroyed.

name: Sudden Winds
description: Reaction. Invoke a sudden breeze as a reaction to an enemy's ranged attack. They have disadvantage on the roll.

name: Winds of the Wild
description: Summon strong winds in one direction in a 300 ft long 100 ft wide line. Creatures moving with the wind have doubled MS, against it halved MS. Ranged attacks with the wind have advantage, others disadvantage.

name: Grappling Plant
description: Enchant a plant within range (secret choice). First creature within 5 ft must STR save or be grappled (lose one limb, rooted). At end of each turn while grappled, take piercing damage (ignores armor), then repeat save.

name: Vine Transport
description: A vine sprouts and transports you to another unoccupied location within range. Cannot sprout through solid thick cement or floor.

name: Boulder Strike
description: Launch a giant boulder (15 ft radius sphere) at a point. Creatures must CON save, taking crushing damage and being knocked prone on fail, or half damage on success.

name: Shield of Anger
description: All damage you deal until end of turn is also added as temporary HP. The shield lasts for the duration.

name: Druidic Poison
description: Enhance your weapon with poison. Weapon attacks deal [3x spell mod + 3/level + 3d10] poison damage (NOT bonus damage). Each attack adds a toxicity stack to the foe.

name: Enraging Venom
description: Target makes WIS save. On fail takes poison damage and you pick an ally within 30 ft; target is taunted by that ally until end of their next turn.

name: Green Regeneration
description: Target is instantly healed for [3x spell mod + 18 + 3d6] and heals at start of each of their turns for [3x spell mod + 10 + 3d6] for the duration.

name: Earth Travel
description: After 1 minute of channelling, you and up to 10 willing creatures are absorbed by the earth and travel to a place within range via an uninterrupted natural route. Must have seen the place or know the location.

name: Skyfall
description: 5 star-like flares strike from the sky, distributed as you choose. Ranged spell attack for each; on hit deals fire damage per flare. Double damage at nighttime.

name: Acid Rain
description: Create acid rain in 40 ft radius. Creatures starting turn there lose 10 PA and gain 2 toxicity (stacks each turn). Lose 1 stack per turn outside. PA reduction is permanent for metal armor. Protect up to [spell mod] creatures.

name: Living Spores
description: Spores cover all enemies within range (CON save, no repeat). While covered: speed drops 10/turn, disadvantage on attacks. After 3 rounds spores explode for massive poison damage. Spores dispel on caster death.

name: Lashing Thorns
description: Summon thorns in 20 ft radius centered on a point. All creatures DEX save; on fail take piercing damage and are snared. Half damage and no snare on success.

name: Toxic Infection
description: Melee spell attack. On hit target gains 4 toxicity levels and becomes weakened (half damage) for the duration. CON save to end the weakened effect.

name: Healing Wave
description: Heal up to [spell modifier] creatures within range.

name: Force of Nature
description: Unleash nature's force in 100 ft radius. Enemies DEX save: on fail take piercing damage + 20d8 poison at start of turn; half piercing on success. Clears all surfaces/clouds. Allies healed and poison/burning effects end.

name: Druidic Overcharge
description: Cast 3 different spells with no AP cost this turn. The 3 spells must be different. Cannot be cast twice on the same turn.

name: Flowers of the Sky
description: Summon up to [spell modifier] gigantic plants as 15 ft radius platforms. All creatures on them when spawned are raised 10,000 ft above the ground.

name: Nature's Promise
description: For the duration all your spells cost 0 mana and half AP (rounded down, min 1). When the duration ends, your spirit leaves your body, which disintegrates. Only godly magic can bring you back.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Ranged spell attack dealing lightning damage to a single target.

name: Rain
description: Create a rain cloud (30 ft radius) centered on a point. All creatures become wet, fire surfaces extinguished, empty/poison surfaces become water. Wet creatures are automatically electrified when damaged by your spells (no extra mana).

name: Lightning Hammer
description: Force a creature to make a STR save. On fail takes lightning damage. Electrified bonus: target is pushed back 20 ft.

name: Lightning Orb
description: Spawn a floating orb at a point within range. It takes a turn after each of yours, casting Lightning Bolt at the closest hostile creature within 30 ft. Orb has 13 AC and 5 HP per your level.

name: Lightning Ray
description: Shoot a lightning ray in a 90 ft long 5 ft wide line. All creatures hit must DEX save or take lightning damage. Electrified bonus: affected targets' weapon attacks cost 1 more AP next round.

name: Wrathful Guardian
description: Cause environmental effects: slam doors open/shut, extinguish or light candles/torches, amplify your voice up to 10x with thunderous tones, make your eyes appear electrified.

name: Lightning Swap
description: Ranged spell attack. On hit deals lightning damage. If you hit another target with this spell same turn, targets swap positions. Can recast same turn at no extra mana. Electrified bonus: can swap target with ally/object (CHA save).

name: Ceaseless Storm
description: Mark a spot within range. At end of each of your turns, lightning strikes 10 ft radius around the spot. DEX save or take lightning damage. Can move the spot for 3 AP.

name: Continuous Electricity
description: Channel. A ray of electricity strikes in a 60 ft long 10 ft wide line at end of every channelling turn. DEX save, full or half damage. You choose direction each turn. Electrified bonus: disadvantage on saves vs lightning until end of your next turn.

name: Bolt of Fright
description: Ranged spell attack dealing lightning damage. Electrified bonus: target must WILL save or run 2 AP worth of MS away from you.

name: Magic Absorption
description: Force a creature to make an INT save. On fail, reduce their MA by 7 and increase yours by the same for the duration. Cannot reduce below 0. Cannot affect more than 1 creature at a time, does not stack.

name: Staggering Bolt
description: Ranged spell attack dealing lightning damage. Electrified bonus: if target moves next turn, must CON save or fall prone, ending turn early.

name: Disruptive Lightning
description: Reaction. When a target casts channelling or concentration spell, strike with lightning. WILL save or take lightning damage (ALWAYS ignores armor) and break channel/concentration. Auto-fail if spell was 2nd level or lower.

name: Wonderous Lightning
description: Force an enemy to DEX save. On fail takes lightning damage, half on success. Electrified bonus: you choose damage type between fire, lightning, and light.

name: Chain Lightning
description: STR save. On fail takes lightning damage and is pushed back 10 ft. Lightning bounces to nearest target (repeat save/damage), pushing them from direction it came. Chains until hitting a target twice. Can hit allies. Electrified bonus: halve or double push distance.

name: Stunning Mark
description: Mark a target. If you deal lightning damage 5 times to it by end of your next turn, target is stunned for 3 turns (CON save). If done same turn, cannot repeat save at end of first turn.

name: Dazing Blast
description: Blast of lightning in 10 ft radius area. All enemies CON save; on fail take lightning damage, half on success. Electrified bonus: targets are also blinded on failed save.

name: Quickened Lightning
description: Ranged spell attack dealing lightning damage. Electrified bonus: also instantly cast a 1st level spell on the target, free of AP and mana (must be in range). Scaling: bonus spell level = this spell's cast level / 2 (rounded down).

name: Electroreceptors
description: Give a creature a new sense: feel anything within 10 ft as if touching it, regardless of light/blindness. Touching a wall reveals thickness and what's within 5 ft on the other side.

name: Lightning Assault
description: Channel. At end of each turn, lightning bolts equal to AP consumed channelling that turn strike targets. Each target DEX save or take lightning damage.

name: Precise Shock
description: Ranged spell attack dealing lightning damage. Electrified bonus: choose the value of each die, and optionally decrease your spell modifier value. Can choose 0 for dice.

name: Staff of Valor
description: Your staff gets hit by lightning. For the duration, make ranged spell attacks (basic attacks, not weapon) with 60 ft range dealing lightning damage.

name: Wall of Lightning
description: Create a wall of lightning up to 200 ft long. Creatures passing through must WILL save. On fail: full damage, pushed back, knocked prone, turn ends. On success: half damage, can pass. Lightning-immune creatures unaffected. Electrified bonus: stunned instead of prone.

name: Silencing Current
description: Force a creature to CON save. On fail takes lightning damage. Electrified bonus: target is also silenced until end of your next turn.

name: Stacking Shock
description: Wave of electricity in 15 ft radius area. All creatures STR save or take lightning damage. Electrified bonus: target is pulled towards center of area.

name: Flash
description: Mark an unoccupied space you can see within range. The first time you deal lightning damage, you are teleported there.

name: Lightning of Oblivion
description: Channel. At end of every channelling turn, strike a 10 ft radius area with a fist of lightning. CON save or take lightning damage and be rooted until end of your next turn. Half damage and no root on success. Electrified bonus: snared instead of rooted.

name: Lightning Shield
description: Shield a creature, increasing their MA by 20. Weapon attacks against the target cause the attacker to be struck by a lightning bolt (piercing armor).

name: Tracking Lightning
description: INT save. On fail takes lightning damage and a halo of electricity appears. If target tries to hide/go invisible, halo shines, deals [5x spell mod] lightning (pierces armor) and the effect fails. Half damage on success. Electrified bonus: also prevents teleportation.

name: Lightning Cage
description: CHA save. On fail takes [5x spell mod + 19 + 56] lightning damage and a circular wall of lightning surrounds the target (20 ft tall, no roof). Nothing can pass through. Electrified bonus: target cannot fly out.

name: Shock Wave
description: Channel. At end of each channelling turn, emit a shock wave. All creatures within range CON save or take lightning damage and be knocked prone.

name: Warding Shock
description: INT save. On fail takes lightning damage; on success half. If failed, choose a creature to ward: enemy has doubled AP cost on attacks/spells targeting the warded creature and moving toward them. Electrified bonus: duration increased to 3 turns.

name: Repulse
description: Strike the ground, creating an impact wave. All creatures within range STR save or be pushed back 3d4 x 10 ft. All targets take force damage regardless of save. Electrified bonus: halved MS until end of your next turn.

name: Discharge
description: Place a lightning pulse in a target with trigger value [5x spell mod + 150 + 5d10]. Lightning damage adds to pulse. Under trigger: half pulse as damage. Exact trigger: 2x pulse as true damage. Over trigger: heals target. Electrified bonus: trigger tolerance of +/-5.

name: Versatile Nature
description: Choose a damage type between light, fire, and shadow. Deal that type instead of lightning for the duration, but spells no longer apply electrify.

name: Lightning Barrage
description: Channel. Throw staff into sky and levitate 20 ft. A storm conjured above; at end of every turn all enemies in range DEX save or take lightning damage, half on success. Electrified bonus: target cannot leave storm range while channelling.

name: Storm of Shades
description: Channel a multi-colored storm. Each turn summon [AP consumed / 3] bolts. Roll 1d4 per bolt: 1=green (heals), 2=blue (CON save or stunned), 3=red (DEX save, fire damage), 4=yellow (petrified 1 turn).

name: Shock Duality
description: CON save. On fail, target alternates between lightning immunity (1 round) and double lightning damage (1 round), starting with immune. Cannot repeat save; spells can end the effect.

name: High Voltage
description: WILL save. On fail takes lightning damage and 1 positive effect on them ends. Half damage and no dispel on success. Electrified bonus: choose which effect ends (some are non-dispellable).

name: Prophecy of Woe
description: Choose a target and secretly name an act against nature. If the target does it within a week, takes 600 true damage. The act must be specific (burn a tree, kill an animal, etc.). Does not take effect if forced, mind-controlled, or in self-defense.

name: Lightning Shift
description: Launch up to [spell modifier] lightning bolts. Each target must CHA save or be teleported to an adjacent plane (random). If willingly failing, you choose the plane. Success grants 24-hour immunity.

name: Judgementbringer
description: Channel. At end of your next turn (having channelled), strike a foe with a lightning spear of Valor. Electrified bonus: roll 1d12; if target's might is <= the roll, instant kill.

name: Winds of the Apocalypse
description: After 3 turns channelling, summon apocalyptic winds. CON save or be pulled into the tornado. Creatures in the way take crushing damage every turn (ignores armor). Airborne creatures can attack/cast with disadvantage. Tornado moves 1d10 x 10 ft your chosen direction each turn.

name: Nature's Power
description: Draw power from surrounding nature. For the duration, AP recovery increases by 1 for each natural element present in range: trees, animals, lakes/rivers, caves/tunnels/terrain surfaces (max +4).

name: Storm of Fate
description: Channel a cosmic storm. All marked creatures (you choose who to protect) take lightning damage at end of each channelling turn, no matter where they are. Pierces armor and almost all protective effects. Electrified bonus: target's location is revealed.

name: Lightning Mastery
description: Overload for the duration. Lightning damage you deal is doubled. All spells electrify all targets hit (no cost). Electrify standard damage becomes 5d10 instead of 1d10.

name: Nature's Voice
description: You and up to [spell modifier] creatures become immune to silence for the duration (silenced effect ends on them). Cannot be overwritten by anything short of god powers.

name: Ascension
description: Ascend 10,000 ft into the sky until end of your next turn. Can still take damage if creatures have means. Casting ranges increased by 20,000 ft. Return to ground at end of next turn.
